name: DowntimeEventLogger
tagline: Every stop recorded, every cause on the Pareto.
description: Shop-floor downtime capture for Power Apps and Power Pages: one-tap start and stop with a live timer, a reason-code tree for planned and unplanned stops, automatic micro-stops, editing, splitting and validation, a shift timeline, availability against target and a downtime Pareto, all stored as JSON in one column.
features: Big Running / Down banner with live timer and one-tap Start / End downtime
Reason-code tree with planned and unplanned categories, groups, search and recent reasons
Automatic micro-stop detection and a list of stops still needing a reason
Edit, split, add a past stop and delete, with overlap and time validation
Shift timeline, availability vs target, MTBF/MTTR and a downtime Pareto by reason or group
20+ outputs including availabilityPercent, paretoJson and isValid, plus a browser change event
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support, configurable labels
